items.title: Uber Technologies (UBER) Plans More Than 2,000 Robotaxis Across Europe And Middle East
items.summary: Uber Technologies (NYSE:UBER) and Pony.ai announced an expanded partnership to deploy over 2,000 Level 4 robotaxis across Europe and the Middle East. The roll out marks Uber's next large scale autonomous vehicle push and moves beyond earlier pilot projects into multi region operations. The collaboration pairs Pony.ai's autonomous driving technology with Uber's ride hailing platform to support broader commercial robotaxi services.
